youtube_short.title: 80% of Medical Bills Have a Hidden Error
title_alternatives: Your Hospital Bill Has a $1,300 Mistake In It
5 Words That Save You $1,300 on Medical Bills
youtube_short.description: Most people have no idea that 80% of medical bills contain at least one billing error — and the average mistake costs $1,300. Hospitals send you a one-line summary on purpose, which keeps errors completely hidden. But here's what almost nobody knows: you have a legal right to an itemized bill. Call the billing department, say 'Send me an itemized bill,' and compare it line by line to your Explanation of Benefits from your insurer. Any mismatch is disputable — and hospitals resolve most of them without a fight. #medicalbills #personalfinance #savemoney #moneytips #healthcare

hook_line: 80% of Medical Bills Have a $1,300 Error
